what_it_is: An English-language volume-per-subject publication in which each issue examines one person, place or idea through portfolios, conversations, essays, fashion editorials and archival documents, in a format designed to be kept rather than read once. Volume 16 revisits 1920s European modernist interiors through the archive of photographer Thérèse Bonney. It is for readers of fashion, art and design publishing who collect photography books.
